name: Safety Core Control Interface
inputs: Declared integrity, approval, incident, and recovery evidence
Explicit filesystem roots for backup or recovery
outputs: SafetyDecision with allow, deny, or review status
Hash-chained audit receipt when a ledger is configured
Integrity, monitoring, backup, recovery, or incident result
compatibility: Local in-process Python and local CLI contract 0.2.x. It is not a network API. Breaking decision, field, or failure-semantic changes require a new governed contract version.
